user: Please look up transaction TX-0401 in my account records and verify its amount. Then explain which reason codes could apply; I have not yet told you what happened.
answer:
**TX-0401 verified:** EUR 240.00, card payment to **TechMart Online** on 2026-07-20, status settled, outgoing from account ACC-1005.

Note that **TX-0402** is also a settled EUR 240.00 card payment to TechMart Online, on 2026-07-14. If you were charged twice, that pair is the relevant one.

**Reason codes that could apply.** These are the codes I can open a dispute under, with their windows from the transaction date (per the dispute rules):

| Reason code | Window | Typically applies when |
|---|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | 60 days | The same purchase was charged more than once |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 days | A payment was taken without your authorization |
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 days | Your card details were used fraudulently for an online payment |
| goods_not_received | 90 days | You paid but did not receive the goods |
| service_not_rendered | 90 days | You paid but the service was not provided |

Which of these fits depends on what happened. Tell me, and I can check eligibility for the relevant code. I have not opened anything. The eligibility check will confirm whether the window is still open for TX-0401, and no dispute will be filed without your confirmation.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
